use_case: Clinical decision support (sepsis prediction) model: scores adult ED and inpatient encounters every 15 minutes and alerts the nurse above a threshold
vendor_or_model: EHR vendor predictive model (module of SYS-H1)
data_categories: Vital signs; laboratory results; nursing assessments; medications; age (ePHI)
human_in_the_loop: The alert prompts a nurse sepsis screen; clinicians decide every action; the model never places orders
applicable_laws: 45 CFR 92.210(a)-(c) (age is an input); 42 CFR 482.21 (QAPI monitoring); HIPAA (EHR vendor BAA); ONC HTI-1 decision support transparency duties fall on the certified EHR developer (45 CFR 170.315(b)(11)); HTI-5 proposal to remove them is not final

use_case: Inpatient deterioration index: EHR vendor score that ranks inpatients by risk of deterioration for rapid response rounds
vendor_or_model: EHR vendor predictive model (module of SYS-H1)
data_categories: Vital signs; laboratory results; nursing assessments; age (ePHI)
human_in_the_loop: Rapid response nurses use the ranked list alongside their own rounds; no automatic escalation

use_case: Ambient AI scribe pilot drafting ED physician notes from recorded encounters
vendor_or_model: AI scribe vendor (speech-to-text and language model) under a BAA with no-training terms
human_in_the_loop: Physician reviews, edits, signs, and attests every note; recording starts only after consent
applicable_laws: HIPAA (BAA); state recording consent laws (Fla. Stat. 934.03(2)(d) worked example: all parties must consent); 45 CFR 92.210 if suggestion features are enabled

use_case: CT intracranial hemorrhage triage that reorders the radiology worklist
vendor_or_model: Imaging AI vendor (device software; vendor states FDA clearance)
human_in_the_loop: A radiologist reads every study; the tool only changes worklist order
applicable_laws: HIPAA (BAA); 45 CFR 92.210; FDA device requirements apply to the manufacturer (clearance and labeling verified before use)

use_case: Generative drafting of replies to patient portal messages for clinician review
vendor_or_model: EHR vendor generative feature (hosted large language model under the EHR BAA)
human_in_the_loop: Clinician edits and sends every reply; drafts are never sent automatically
applicable_laws: HIPAA (BAA); POL-05 4.7; patient-facing disclosure of AI use (group standard)

use_case: Prior authorization triage model for Medicare Advantage requests (shadow mode)
data_categories: Authorization requests; diagnoses; claims history; age (PHI)
human_in_the_loop: Shadow mode only: scores are logged, never shown to reviewers; any future use requires UM committee approval and physician review of every expected adverse decision
applicable_laws: 42 CFR 422.137(b), (d); 422.101(c)(1)(i); 422.566(d); HIPAA; 45 CFR 92.210 applicability under counsel review before production

use_case: Fraud, waste, and abuse model flagging provider claims for pre-payment review
human_in_the_loop: Investigators review every flag; no automatic denial
applicable_laws: HIPAA; state prompt-pay and insurance laws (generic)

use_case: Online exam proctoring that records webcam video and flags possible misconduct
vendor_or_model: Proctoring SaaS vendor (face detection and behavior flags)
data_categories: Webcam video and audio; face detection data; exam activity (education records)
human_in_the_loop: Faculty review every flag before any academic action; students can appeal
applicable_laws: FERPA (vendor as school official, 34 CFR 99.31(a)(1)(i)(B)); Fla. Stat. 501.702 biometric definition (applicability to video-derived face data unsettled; treated as biometric); Colorado SB26-189 under counsel review for Colorado online students (effective 2027-01-01)

use_case: AI tutoring assistant answering nursing students' questions on course material
vendor_or_model: Education AI vendor (no training on student data; no PHI permitted)
human_in_the_loop: Faculty set the content; the assistant does not grade

use_case: Enterprise generative AI assistant for the workforce (drafting and summarizing internal documents)
vendor_or_model: Enterprise AI assistant under a BAA with no-training terms
data_categories: Internal documents; PHI only in the enterprise tenant for approved roles
human_in_the_loop: Users review outputs; prohibited for clinical, coverage, or academic decisions
